LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.3 Reading for Understanding (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Com
Topic 2.4: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading 2.3 Reading for Understanding (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Com in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we enhance reading fluency?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording about time phrases and read along the words aloud (早上、上午 、下午、晚上),

2. match puzzle pieces of different moments in the 12-hour clock with their corresponding names,

3. read the time on clock faces in Chinese using 点 and 分钟,

4. role-play reading simple sentences using words and phrases ( 半 bàn,刻 kè,差 chà ) related to telling time in 12-hour clock,

5. take turns to talk about the time they undertake various learning areas using the school timetable (e.g. 你们几点上汉语 课?我们每天下午 4 点上汉语课。),

6. create a talking wall in the classroom on the importance of managing time while in school for effectiveness with peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording about time phrases and read along the words aloud (早上、上午 、下午、晚上),
2. match puzzle pieces of different moments in the 12-hour clock with their corresponding names,
3. read the time on clock faces in Chinese using 点 and 分钟,
4. role-play reading simple sentences using words and phrases ( 半 bàn,刻 kè,差 chà ) related to telling time in 12-hour clock,
5. take turns to talk about the time they undertake various learning areas using the school timetable (e.g. 你们几点上汉语 课?我们每天下午 4 点上汉语课。),
6. create a talking wall in the classroom on the importance of managing time while in school for effectiveness with peers.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: the learner contributes to group decision making when they participate actively in reading

simple sentences using the given words and phrases with peers.

Values:
Unity: the learner displays team spirit as they take turns to talk about the time that they undertake various learning areas in school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Time management is developed when the learner collaborates with peers to create a talking wall in the classroom on the value of

managing time while in school.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Mathematics on the use of time to quantify, measure and compare the duration and sequence

of events.
